title: KYC periodic review

steps.title: Open the first review on the list
Link the director's renewed passport from her own customer record
Upload the new proof of address and verify it
Update the risk factors and re-score the customer
Escalate the review to enhanced due diligence
Record a review note for the EDD team

decisions: If a newer copy of an expired document is already held (e.g. on the director's personal record), link it; otherwise request it from the customer.

If the re-scored risk is 70 or above (High), escalate to enhanced due diligence and do not approve the review yourself; below 70, approve it and set the next review date (two years for Medium, three for Low).
warnings: Do not approve a review while an expired document is still on file: the system allows it, but it fails the quality check and the review is reopened.
openQuestions: Whether Vossland is on the high-risk country list under the new policy (it changes the score): Femi will confirm with the financial crime policy team.
